title: evt.notification.requested v1
description: A service asks for a notification on one channel. Published by any service (through its outbox) on the platform's events exchange and consumed by krizaka-notifications, which renders the template in the locale and delivers it. The body is the bare request; the envelope travels in the kz-* AMQP headers.

recipient.description: An e-mail address, an E.164 phone number or a webhook URL, by channel.

locale.description: A BCP 47 language tag; only the language is used, en when absent.
